result.instructions: Tools for Regi, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which WhatsApp numbers does our Regi account send from?"; "List our approved message templates and how many variables each one needs."; "Send the cliente_bienvenida template to 5492611234567 with the name Juan Perez and order PS-1234.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Regi data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run regi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run regi_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run regi_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. regi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: regi_list_phone_numbers
tools.title: List WhatsApp phone numbers
tools.description: List the WhatsApp Business phone numbers of the Regi account. Each `id` is the phoneNumberId that regi_send_template needs. Use this first when you do not know the phoneNumberId.

only_active.description: Default true: return only numbers enabled for sending.

tools.name: regi_list_templates
tools.title: List message templates
tools.description: List the WhatsApp message templates of the Regi account with name, language, category and status. Only templates with status APPROVED can be sent. The componentsJson field shows how many {{n}} variables the body expects.

tools.name: regi_send_template
tools.title: Send a WhatsApp template
tools.description: Send one approved WhatsApp template to one recipient. This bills per message and reaches a real person. Regi blocks a second send of a template to the same recipient within 2 hours until the recipient replies (HTTP 400); this tool does not bypass that block. Values in body_parameters fill {{1}}, {{2}}, … in order.

to.description: Recipient in international format without '+', digits only.

body_parameters.description: Values for the body variables {{1}}, {{2}}, … in order. Omit when the template has no variables.
